mission: 1.62 — Anchor Operational Closure & Partner Package Completion V1

canonical_baseline.$comment: Measured live against the deployment before any work, via a read-only query. Section 0 requires measurement rather than trust in the expected values.

scope_freeze.$comment: Section 17. The exact four apparatus subjects carried from Missions 1.60 and 1.61. No candidate four.

brief_attribution_correction.$comment: Sections 21 and 22 each instruct 'resolve exact candidate from artifact'. Doing so found the two blockers attributed to the wrong candidates in the brief, which is why that instruction exists.
brief_attribution_correction.resolution: The artifact governs, as sections 21 and 22 direct. Both blockers were pursued against the candidate that actually carries them.
brief_attribution_correction.why_this_is_recorded: A mission that silently re-attributed a blocker would leave the next reader unable to tell which candidate was actually investigated.

documentation_ledger.$comment: Section 48. Bounded first-party retrieval across anchor closure, three partner packages and the contact-channel lookup.
documentation_ledger.unusable_reason: five requests returned HTTP 404 or a page whose content did not load; each is counted against the budget because it was spent

request_accounting.$comment: Section 49. Every one of the required counters is zero.
request_accounting.the_count_is_measurement: A query returning only a number still returns a measurement value about the target population. The anchor publishes a count endpoint and it was not called.
request_accounting.the_trial_is_not_free: A zero-cost trial, demo console or search preview destroys preregistration exactly as a paid one would. Access cost is irrelevant to epistemic contamination.
request_accounting.incidental_generic_examples: Documentation pages carry illustrative examples. None was used analytically and none was queried deliberately.
